schema:
CREATE TABLE Method (
  ApiCalls,
  CommentIsXml,
  FullComment,
  Id,
  Lang,
  Name,
  NameTokenized,
  SampledAt,
  SolutionId,
  Summary
);

CREATE TABLE Repo (
  Forks,
  Id,
  ProcessedTime,
  Stars,
  Url,
  Watchers
);

CREATE TABLE Solution (
  Id,
  Path,
  ProcessedTime,
  RepoId,
  WasCompiled
);
